thread:
Emily (Support): @Raj @Sara we have a p99 latency spike reported by ACME's site-ops around 09:10 PDT. Customer sees 3–5s p99 on generation API, intermittent 503s. Raising to eng oncall.
Raj (Eng Runtime): Thanks Emily. Are these requests from a single tenant? Any auth failures or billing errors in the logs?
Emily (Support): Yes, tenant=acme-corp. No auth/billing errors in their report. Just high tails. Logs attached below.
Sara (SRE): Looking at metrics: ingress queue depth for region us-west-2 jumped from ~20 to ~450 at 09:08. Worker concurrency at 100% on edge-workers pool, many requests queued. Could be cold-start storm or sudden traffic fanout.
Raj (Eng Runtime): Noted. Any recent deploys? Also check KV cache hit rates—if cache miss flood, model latency climbs.
Ben (Eng Platform): We did a small scaling change earlier — reduced warmup buffer for edge-workers to save cost. Rolling that back now. Also pushing a temporary increase to concurrency_limit for acme-corp to 64 from 16.
infra-bot: deploy:edge-worker-warmup-rollout started by Ben — roll ID: rw-7782
Emily (Support): Customer confirms traffic spike due to internal batch job retrying. They can throttle but asked for quick mitigation.
Sara (SRE): Hot mitigations: 1) increase tenant concurrency limit (Ben doing), 2) enable prefix KV caching for acme requests, 3) enable fast-fail for requests exceeding admit window to avoid head-of-line blocking.
Raj (Eng Runtime): Repro steps for offline testing: run the following from inside staging loadgen to simulate spikes:
```
for i in {1..500}; do 
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -H "x-tenant: acme-corp" \
    -d '{"input":"hello"}' \
    https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate &
done
wait
```
Look at /metrics request_queue_size and worker_kv_miss_rate.
Ben (Eng Platform): Concurrency bump pushed. Also toggled warmup buffer back to 10s for edge-workers in us-west-2. Watch dashboards: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/ingress/edge-workers?org=acme-corp
Sara (SRE): Early signs: queue depth dropping, p95 back to baseline, p99 still high for ~30s due to inflight KV cold misses. We'll continue to monitor and follow up with root cause.
Emily (Support): Customer updated: saw improvement within ~2min after change. They want RCA and permanent fix.
Raj (Eng Runtime): Action items: - Add tenant-aware warmup policy (auto for long-running batch bursts) - Improve admission control to fast-fail when queue depth > X and tenant exceeds SLAs - Add runbook steps and a quick curl-based repro entry in triage doc.
Ben (Eng Platform): I created ENG-1427 to track warmup policy. Will follow up with timeline.
Sara (SRE): Adding notes to incident tracker. Marking resolved for now; we'll keep an eye for recurring patterns. :white_check_mark:
Emily (Support): Thanks team — passing back to ACME with instructions to stagger retry and contact support if it recurs. :thumbsup:
